verdict.rationale: Anytype's built-in Web Publishing lets you click Publish on an Object inside the app and get a static HTML page on a personal any.org subdomain. That covers publishing selected notes without leaving the app. The evidence only shows per-object pages, not an interlinked, browsable site. missing for 10: evidence that links between published notes resolve to other published pages, site-level navigation or a browsable garden structure, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can publish selected notes as a browsable website — a digital garden with working links — without leaving the app

citations.quote: Web Publishing lets you turn any Object into a public webpage at a URL anyone can visit.
Pick an Object, click Publish, and Anytype generates a static HTML page hosted on your personal subdomain at <your-id>.any.org/<slug>.
Include a custom ANY ID — your unique handle, used for web publishing URLs
